items.title: A 70-Year-Old Swapped O for ADC in a $1.03 Million Income Portfolio. Here’s What Happened to Her $5,650 Monthly Paycheck
items.summary: Two monthly-paying REITs look nearly identical on paper, yet one retiree is betting her income on swapping a giant for a smaller rival. What does she gain, what does she give up, and does her paycheck survive?

items.title: If I Could Give My Younger Self 1 Piece of Investing Advice, This Is What It Would Be
items.summary: There's no substitute for experience, but it still helps to know some important rules of thumb.

items.title: Verizon Yields 6.2%. Is This Dividend Stock a Trap or a Retirement Bargain?
items.summary: A yield this high usually means Wall Street smells a cut, and Verizon is carrying $166 billion in debt after the Frontier deal. Yet one cash flow number and a bold new strategy from the CEO complicate the bear case for income-hungry retirees.

items.title: What Tutor Perini (TPC) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
items.summary: Tutor Perini (NYSE:TPC) raised its 2026 adjusted earnings forecast after reporting record third-quarter revenue and operating cash flow, as activity increased on large construction projects and its backlog approached a record. The contractor now expects adjusted earnings of $5.90 to $6.10 per share

items.title: Why AT&T Stock Slumped in October
items.summary: A large, well-known company continues to push into the consumer telecom space.

items.title: Your Phone Bill Could Pay You Back: $90,000 in These 3 Dividend Stocks Yields $4,967 a Year
items.summary: Wireless service and nicotine pouches generate cash that flows straight to shareholders. But one of these three dividend payers has been frozen since 2022, and heavy debt shadows two of them. Which one deserves your money?

items.title: Musk Says SpaceX Could Buy a Legacy Telco and Use Its Spectrum 10 Times Better
items.summary: Musk hinted at a telecom takeover without naming a target, while a rival CEO put a staggering price on SpaceX's ambitions. Debt, regulators, and a spectrum gap stand between the boast and a real deal.

items.title: Crown Castle Soars 31% in a Month on SpaceX’s Tower Push: “We’re Talking to All Parties”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrown Castle (CCI) stock surged 31% from October 2 to November 2, closing at $87. 03 as SpaceX (SPCX) pursued wireless spectrum and potential tower leases.
